author: IceyPoop
body:
IGN: IceyPoop
Reason For Ban: "Ban Evading"
Why I should be unbanned: I should be unbanned because I was banned falsely. I know my first time I got banned was right, I was hacking, and I know I wont do it again. But know Pelpelajax thinks I was ban evading. In my most recent appeal, he stated that EthanHuang was my alt. I already told him, and so did PingHacks, my friend, that we were all at a sleepover. EthanHuang, PingHacks, and 3 other friends were at my house, I wont name them because I forgot their minecraft usernames but they werent playing avicus. Anyways, PingHacks, was banned for "IceyPoop" because Pelpelajax thought he was Ban Evading from my account or something. Then Pelpelajax just said he read his ip history wrong or something. That was probably because everyone in my house was connected to the same wifi network, there fore we have the same ip. Then thats why you thought my alt was EthanHuang, and I was PingHacks alt. But that is not the case, I am IceyPoop, EthanHuang is EthanHuang, and PingHacks is PingHacks. If you could give me a second chance I really want to join back. PingHacks has some how persuaded me to come back on this server. I was watching him play nebula, I really want to play it again. Can you please give me a second chance?

Thanks,
IceyPoop

title: Another False Ban "Ban Evading"

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

Regarding the fact there is no evidence to dispute your ban I will appeal it, furthermore I will keep this open if you reply asking for Ethan to be unbanned as your friend may want to play on Avicus, so just ask here and I shall appeal him as your explanation seems plausible.
I warn though, don't ever think hacking on Avicus is allowed in any way again, with that out of the way... welcome back! :)
-Appealed

Regards,
Auratix,
Senior Moderator
